comment.en: The government rejected ETS2 by resolution at its first session (16 Dec 2025) and is actively negotiating at EU level. Babiš announced concrete solutions for the February European Council summit, but factual legislative or executive measures for cheaper energy (apart from reducing the renewable energy fee) are not documented. The 10% electricity price reduction was approved as a government regulation amendment (16 Dec 2025), but it is a temporary measure without long-term legislative anchoring.

change.cs: Ministr životního prostředí (pozice dlouhodobě neobsazena) zaslal dopis EU s konkrétními návrhy na revizi ETS2 (20. 4. 2026), ale bez výsledku v legislativě.
change.en: The environment minister (position long vacant) sent a letter to the EU with specific proposals for ETS2 revision (20 Apr 2026), but without legislative results.

Illegal migration in first half of 2026 increased by 6.9%. Without legislative action truly implementing zero tolerance, this is only a declaration.
